title: Physical Damage Coverage Deductible Schedule by Package
content:
Each deductible package of the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) sets two deductibles: a comprehensive (other than collision) deductible, applied once per comprehensive loss per vehicle, and a collision deductible, applied once per collision loss per vehicle. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Package | Comprehensive deductible (USD) | Collision deductible (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,500 Deductible | 2500 | 2500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 2000 | 2000 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible | 1500 | 1500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 1000 | 1000 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 500 | 500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible | 250 | 500 |

### Glass and application terms (identical in all six packages)

| Term | Setting in every package |
|---|---|
| Windshield zero-deductible states (garaging states in which no deductible applies to windshield repair or replacement under comprehensive) | Florida |
| Deductible waived when damaged glass is repaired rather than replaced | Yes |
| How deductibles apply | Once per loss per vehicle, by cause: collision or comprehensive |
| How the deductible is returned after a subrogation recovery | In proportion to the share of total damages recovered |

### Reading the schedule

- Only the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible package carries two different figures: 250 USD for a comprehensive loss and 500 USD for a collision loss. In each of the other five packages the two deductibles are the same figure.
- The cause of the loss decides which of the two columns is read. A vehicle damaged by collision in the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible package reads the collision column (1500 USD). The same vehicle damaged by a comprehensive cause reads the comprehensive column, which in that package is also 1500 USD.
- Florida is the only windshield zero-deductible state listed for any package.
